purpose: Supplemental classification-only baseline, registered before root sees substantive TEST labels/bodies or any new candidate outputs. Primary Q4/Q8 generation protocol unchanged.
probabilityMetrics: Brier and10equal-width-bin ECE on first repetition labeled inputs, stratified; uncertain excluded; no threshold fitting on TEST. Repeat inputs not independent quality samples.
outputSemantics: Only query/skip decision and probability, never a generated query. Compare binary decision outcomes separately from full rewriter semantic quality.
reuse: Existing strict local TypeSafe client, current production decision rules and six example inputs/verdicts, existing guarded owned-runtime lifecycle.
contextFailure: No clipping. Three initial protocol/admission failures stop an incomplete run, not a poor-quality score.
preInferenceCorrection: Disposable-runtime recovery uses an actual owned SIGKILL/restart; no question, input, threshold or model change. Root remains blind to substantive labels/bodies.
